en: Kid Elon. Mars is still coming soon.
Jailed Elon. The savings don't add up.
Just Elon. He posts. That's the job.
Saint Elon. Tremendous rockets. Dirty replies.
God Elon. The boosters land. Believe me.
Ancestor Elon. The solar system takes his name.

zh: 花都谢了。V4 还在即将。
en: Delayed Liang. The flowers already wilted.
Jailed Liang. You delayed again.
Just Liang. Pro missed the hype.
Saint Liang. That's Flash, not Pro.
God Liang. Silicon Valley got cut.
Ancestor Liang. Open source takes his name.

zh: 小难杨，下一 mil 还在排队。
杨神！K3 把芯片股砍了。
en: Delayed Yang. Next mil still in line.
Jailed Yang. Context window closed.
Just Yang. Babyface. Company might die.
Saint Yang. Model and moon. No ads.
Moon God. K3 ate the chip stocks.
Ancestor Yang. Dark side of the moon.

zh: 小难码，发布会日期又擦了。
码圣！默认参照系，心虚圣。
en: Delayed Sam. Keynote date got erased.
Jailed Sam. Board fired you Friday.
Just Sam. It's the forehead.
Saint Sam. Default model. Sweaty halo.
God Sam. The GPT moment guy.
Ancestor Sam. The compiler takes his name.

zh: 小难奥，礼貌先到模型后到。
奥子。就是那个很有礼貌的人。
奥圣！写代码还是先开 Claude。
奥神！然后被出口管制掐了。
en: Delayed Dario. Polite first, model later.
Jailed Dario. Quotas vanished. Doge.
Just Dario. Very polite. That's the bit.
Saint Dario. Coders still open Claude first.
God Dario. Then an export control.
Ancestor Dario. Please refuse first.
Delayed Tibo. Pray for reset.
Jailed Tibo. Button only. No sleep.
Just Tibo. Black hoodie. Giant button.
Saint Tibo. Believers kept vigil.
God Tibo. Hi. It is done.
Ancestor Tibo. Limits take his name.
